source: Build a dark fantasy alchemy laboratory for a citadel. Include: dark lab tables with bubbling green chemical vials, tall glowing containment tanks filled with green liquid, pipes running along the walls and ceiling, futuristic pods, dark metal walls with warning symbols, a grated metal floor, smoky vents releasing green fog, and eerie green lighting. Dark fantasy science aesthetic. Colors: black, dark grey, glowing toxic green, purple accents. Expose attributes for: tank glow color, pod count, room size, and fog intensity.
scene_prompt: Build a dark fantasy science alchemy laboratory inside a citadel: a large enclosed room with black and dark-grey metal walls marked by warning symbols, a grated metal floor, and pipes running along the walls and ceiling. Arrange dark laboratory tables with bubbling green chemical vials through the central work area, with tall glowing containment tanks of green liquid along the side and back walls and futuristic pods placed around the room. Smoky wall and ceiling vents release green fog beneath eerie toxic-green lighting, with purple accent illumination. The tank glow color, pod count, room size, and fog intensity are configurable.
blob:
### Genre
`No Genre`: this is an environment build with no stated gameplay loop, scoring, combat, route, or objective. The prompt decides `enclosure` as `interior-only`; `verticality`, `zone-count`, `structure`, and `play-space` remain at their free defaults of single-surface, single, dressed, and grounded-surface. No No Genre preset applies because the request is a specific interior set rather than an explorable or social-space program.

### Shape and preset
No shape is selected for `No Genre`. The interior-only axis means one enclosed citadel laboratory, not an exterior compound or linked indoor/outdoor spaces.

### Config requirements
No menu options are implied beyond the interior axis. The laboratory furnishings, pipes, tanks, pods, fog, lighting, and warning markings are direct visible scene geometry and dressing, not separate gameplay options. Preserve tank glow color, pod count, room size, and fog intensity as configurable visual build attributes; do not depict UI, triggers, or scripts. There are no invisible layout components.

### Layout components
Build one large rectangular enclosed laboratory chamber. Black and dark-grey metal walls surround a grated metal floor; walls carry warning symbols. A broad central work zone holds dark laboratory tables distributed as work islands, each dressed with bubbling green chemical vials. Line the side walls and much of the rear wall with tall glowing containment tanks filled with green liquid, leaving clear circulation around the central tables. Place futuristic pods around the room perimeter and between appropriate wall sections, with their count configurable. Run exposed pipes continuously along upper walls and across the ceiling. Set smoky vents into walls and ceiling so green fog releases downward and across the floor-level work area. Use eerie toxic-green illumination from tanks, vials, and vents, balanced by restrained purple accent lights. The room boundary is the sealed metal citadel interior. Compose the view diagonally across the central tables toward the tank-lined back wall, showing ceiling pipes, fog, and the chamber’s full depth.

### Render order
Use `isometric`: render the atmospheric isometric laboratory first as authoritative, then derive the top-down view. The scene has no topology whose failure would make play impossible.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Use a large scale, driven by the stated large room, central work area, perimeter tanks, pods, and broad circulation. Theme: dark-fantasy science, industrial citadel, blackened metal, toxic green glow, and purple accents. Use `P0`; this is one enclosed, single-surface room with no stacked traversal, exterior/interior crossing, separate maps, or validity-by-construction requirement.
